categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies `ci/test/03_test_script.sh` to filter subtree paths before running IWYU in CI.
categories.rationale: Filters excluded subtree paths out of the compilation database during CI IWYU runs to avoid discarded suggestions and reduce log noise. Reviewers note this provides a 'minimal speed-up and minimally smaller ci log output', which represents minor friction reduction for internal tooling.
